result.description:
Workshop Planner for Construction Machinery Manufacturers   
  Workshop Planner  
 Location: Revesby, NSW Pay Rate: $50 per hour + super Duration: 6-month contract (full-time hours) with potential to go permanent 
   
  The Opportunity  
 A well-established construction machinery manufacturing company in Revesby is seeking a Workshop Planner to join their on-site operations. This is a hands-on planning and coordination role responsible for scheduling machinery through the workshop, managing subcontractors, and ensuring all Australian compliance checks are completed. 
 You'll play a key part in keeping large and heavy construction machinery moving through the workshop efficiently-balancing planning, procurement, communication, and technical understanding. This is a 6-month temporary role with strong potential to transition into a permanent position for the right candidate. 
  Key Responsibilities  
 
 Plan and coordinate machinery workflow through the workshop 
 Ensure machinery meets relevant Australian standards and compliance requirements 
 Manage subcontractors and ensure timely delivery of services 
 Oversee movement, purchasing, and procurement of parts for heavy machinery 
 Maintain schedules, track progress, and adjust plans as needed 
 Liaise with workshop teams, engineers, and operations staff 
 Identify bottlenecks and propose practical, outside-the-box solutions 
 Use Microsoft Projects and internal systems to manage timelines and tasks 
 
  About You  
 
 Experience in a workshop, automotive, truck, heavy machinery, or construction environment 
 Background in planning or scheduling, ideally with machinery or vehicles 
 Strong technical understanding; mechanical engineering experience desirable 
 Process-driven mindset with strong organisational skills 
 Confident communicator with the ability to influence and coordinate across teams 
 Creative problem solver able to think outside the box 
 Comfortable using Microsoft Projects or similar tools (training provided) 
 
  Requirements  
 
 Relevant trade or engineering exposure (mechanical, automotive, fabrication, or workshop) 
 Experience with scheduling tools such as Microsoft Projects 
 Full working rights in Australia 
 On-site availability in Revesby 
 
  Why Apply?  
 
 Competitive rate: $50 per hour + super 
 6-month contract with strong potential for permanency 
 Work with a respected construction machinery manufacturer 
 Hands-on role with training provided 
 Supportive workshop and engineering team 
 Opportunity to step into a long-term career pathway 
 
 
 
  Apply Now  
 
 
 If you're a workshop or engineering professional with planning experience and ready for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or email cathal.maguire@hays.com.au.  Please  click here  to apply.
